haikus.haiku:
Red fruit glows in gold,
Sweet warm scent fills all the air,
Red juice drips on ice.
Happy #NationalCherriesJubileeDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Comma dots dance bright
Punctuation sings like rain
Each mark warms the word
Happy #NationalPunctuationDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Candle glow, soft night
Jazz notes swirl in warm air soft
Pages turn, dreams bloom
#HappyBirthdayFScottFitzgerald from @ClamBakeSanta

Gentle wind sighs soft
Leaves dance in silver light glow
Stars hum warm night glow
Happy #WelcomeToLibraSeason from @ClamBakeSanta
